sql.if: AND ( root_session.candidate_name ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR job.title ILIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select: WITH owned_lineages AS ( SELECT * FROM t_interview_lineage WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND archived = FALSE ), focused_branch AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (session.lineage_id) session.lineage_id, session.status AS focused_branch_status FROM t_interview_session session JOIN owned_lineages lineage ON lineage.id = session.lineage_id WHERE session.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY session.lineage_id, CASE session.status WHEN 1 THEN 0 WHEN 2 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, COALESCE( session.last_business_activity_at, session.updated_at, session.created_at ) DESC, session.id DESC ) SELECT COUNT(*) FROM owned_lineages lineage JOIN t_interview_session root_session ON root_session.id = lineage.root_session_id AND root_session.user_id = #{userId} JOIN focused_branch ON focused_branch.lineage_id = lineage.id LEFT JOIN t_job job ON job.id = root_session.job_id WHERE 1 = 1
